TEXT: Well then, how do we get back at them...

We decided to turn our date into one with a 
strategy meeting, so we're headed towards the 
usual karaoke place to talk.

While we were walking towards the station, we 
heard someone's voice.
So this is the first time they have met, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Let me introduce you. She's my childhood friend, 
Tamura Manami.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Won't this turn out gloomy again, since she's going 
to object, just like the others?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: If it's okay with you, I hope we can be friends.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Y-Yeah... please be kind to me as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Mhmm, I'm glad~. If anything's troubling you, feel 
free to come talk to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I feel I can really be useful in these situations.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
...Somehow you seem to be too much of a good 
person, super suspicious...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sorry Manami, even I felt that way myself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well, in her case, it's impossible for her to feign 
kindness.

If this girl's been feigning kindness, then I would 
have been fooled for more than 10 years.
There's no way that could be true.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hey, what are you up to? You're still mad 
regardless of whether people congratulate or 
oppose you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan and I don't have that kind of relationship.
So Kanako was worried over that.

If I put myself in her shoes, she's meeting a boy's 
close childhood friend.
Of course she'd be worried, even a bit jealous.
In situations like this, I'm an idiot, as always.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I hope you can trust Kyou-chan more.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Oh. I don't want to be a bother, so I'm going to 
take my leave now.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I've still got stuff I want to talk about, but... maybe 
next time!
